summary: Patient forgot appointment due to missing reminder message and requested to reschedule for next week.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact details, confirm reminder preferences, and enable automated SMS reminders.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to living far from the clinic and lacking available morning transportation.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or provide information on community medical transportation services for future visits.

summary: Patient skipped the appointment due to high consultation fee concerns.
recommended_action: Inform patient about financial assistance programs or payment plan options.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to high fever and sudden illness.
recommended_action: Follow up with the patient in 2-3 days to check recovery and reschedule.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to an urgent work meeting and requested a future evening appointment.
recommended_action: Reschedule patient for an evening appointment slot as requested.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment because no SMS reminder was received and requested to reschedule.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact details, re-enable automated SMS reminders, and rebook.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a city bus strike preventing travel.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or arrange rideshare assistance during transit disruptions.

summary: Patient was unreachable after three call attempts because their phone was switched off.
recommended_action: Send an automated email or SMS and verify alternate contact details at next visit.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to an unapproved leave request at work.
recommended_action: Update patient preference profile to weekends or late evening slots.
